spec_match.rationale: Demonstrates the primary motivating use case from issue #5071: packing a 32-bit float Z-depth into .y (high word) and a 32-bit triangle ID into .x (low word) for a 64-bit visibility buffer resolved via atomicMin/atomicMax on atomic<vec2u>.

interactive.rationale: Users can adjust Z-depths for three overlapping triangles, switch between atomicMin and atomicMax, invert Z-order, and inspect the 8x8 pixel tile grid and 64-bit hex word breakdown.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Matches the index description of a 64-bit visibility buffer rasterizer packing depth (.y) + triangle ID (.x) into vec2u(triangleId, depthBits).

edge_cases.rationale: Handles both atomicMin and atomicMax reduction orders and gracefully falls back to a bit-exact BigInt 64-bit rasterizer when hardware adapter support is absent.

references.rationale: Links to chromestatus.com/feature/4882016087703552, the W3C WebGPU spec section, and WGSL issue #5071.

conformance.rationale: Probes navigator.gpu and adapter.features.has('atomic-vec2u-min-max') matching the conformance suite.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Verified live WebGPU adapter probe, interactive depth sliders, Z-order inversion button, and 64-bit hex table with zero console errors.

telemetry_health.rationale: Emits showcaseTelemetry assertion for the WebGPU adapter feature probe.

design_system.rationale: Strictly uses CSS variables from /public/styles.css with zero raw hex or rgba colors.

accessibility.rationale: Includes role=img and aria-label on the 8x8 SVG raster grid, labelled 44px range sliders and select controls, and an aria-live=polite readout.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Responsive control grid and viewBox-scaled SVG fit cleanly on 360x740 mobile and 1280x800 desktop screens.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Expose visual canvas state changes through structured DOM tables and aria-live announcements.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Mirrored the 8x8 visibility grid's center overlap pixel (4, 4) into a 4-column hex/decimal breakdown table and aria-live output.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Ensure quick preset triggers are keyboard-operable at 44px height.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Added a 44px Invert Z-order button to flip triangle depth ordering in one keypress.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Provide role=img and descriptive aria-label on graphical SVG outputs.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied role=img and aria-label on the 8x8 SVG visibility grid.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Associate every range slider and select input with an explicit label.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Wrapped all three Z-depth sliders and the atomic operation selector in semantic <label> elements.

summary: Interactive 64-bit depth + triangle ID visibility buffer rasterizer demonstrating vec2u(triangleId, depthBits) packing and atomicMin/atomicMax comparison.
